description: Defines the HttpStreamRequest class and its nested Delegate and Helper classes, which manage HTTP stream creation requests and callbacks within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: net::HttpStreamRequest
classes.description: Represents a client's request to create an HTTP stream, managing callbacks and request state.

classes.name: net::HttpStreamRequest::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback methods to handle success, failure, and special conditions during stream creation.

classes.name: net::HttpStreamRequest::Helper
classes.description: Interface for helper methods related to load state, request completion, proxy auth, and priority management.

methods.name: HttpStreamRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing a stream request with URL, helper, delegate, and other parameters.

methods.name: RestartTunnelWithProxyAuth
methods.description: Resumes a stalled proxy tunnel request after collecting proxy auth credentials.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of the request.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks the request as complete with negotiation details.

methods.name: AddConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Records connection attempts made during the request.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the request.

methods.name: negotiated_protocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol negotiated with the server.

methods.name: alternate_protocol_usage
methods.description: Returns the reason for using a specific transport protocol.

methods.name: using_spdy
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is using SPDY.

methods.name: websocket_handshake_stream_create_helper
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket handshake stream create helper.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the request.

methods.name: net_log
methods.description: Returns the NetLog source for logging.

methods.name: stream_type
methods.description: Returns the type of stream requested.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Returns whether the request has been completed.
